thread:
Maya: Posted the postmortem for the authz token validation outage earlier this week. Need to lock down action items + owners.
Maya: TL;DR: token cache TTL mismatch + permissions sync lag + audit logging gap for third-party rotation.
incident-bot: Postmortem published: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/authz-token-2025-04 (pdf attached) :white_check_mark:
Oliver: thanks. looked at doc. quick q — are we going to keep manual rotations or move to automated KMS/Vault rotations?
Maya: propose: token validation code fix + perms audit + enable audit log retention. Owners suggested below.
Maya: Owners & rough timelines:
- Token TTL normalization -> Alex (eng-runtime) — 2 weeks
- Permissions audit & remediation -> Jean (eng-platform) — 2 weeks
- Audit logging (missing events) -> Oliver (eng-security) — 1 week
- Secrets rotation policy & automation -> Security infra (policy-bot) — PoC 1 week, rollout 4 weeks
Alex: ack. I'll open a PR to normalize TTLs and add integration tests. ETA: 2025-04-15. I'll also add regression test for delayed KV cache invalidation.
Jean: I will run a cross-service permissions diff and create remediation tickets per service. Need prod-iam logs access to run the diff. @Oliver can you grant?
Oliver: granted access to Jean — confirmed in IAM. Also I'll add an alert for permission-change spikes and wire to pager.
Oliver: I'll update the oncall runbook with rollback steps and a section 'authz surge -> disable cache' so we can fast-fail.
Maya: For rotation automation, quick PoC cron:
```
0 3 * * 1 /usr/local/bin/vault-rotate --role=app-service --max-age=30
```
Maya: PoC should show zero-downtime rotation and automatic key rebind. Want this done as a proof next week.
policy-bot: Current policy reminder: secrets rotation default 90 days. Proposal: 30 days for high-priv tokens, 90 days otherwise. Exec approval required for org-wide change.
Jean: I vote 30 days for service-to-service tokens. I'll draft policy change and circulate for comment. Also propose a recurring monthly authz review to track trends and regressions.
Alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inc/redwood/runtime/pull/482 — includes TTL fix and tests. CI green locally, will request review.
Maya: Summary of action items in doc (see postmortem). Please confirm owners and update ticket links there. I'll follow up in 48h with a cadence plan for monthly reviews.
Oliver: Confirmed. :thumbsup:
Jean: Confirmed — will schedule recurring slot and start the perms audit tomorrow.
Maya: Thanks team. Closing this thread once PRs + tickets are linked in the postmortem doc.
